mutations.because: renderMotionVariant must spread the run's resolved music-bed bytes onto the compositor's request whenever audio was resolved, or a brief declaring `audio` would silently render with no music even though the interim refusal is gone. Forcing the conditional spread's guard to false drops the `audio` key from every compositeVideo request unconditionally, caught by the fixture asserting a brief with `audio` gets the resolved bytes on its motion request.

hasAllowedAudioMagic must actually check the mp3 (ID3/frame-sync) or m4a (ftyp/audio-brand) magic before an upload named .mp3/.m4a is accepted, or a renamed PNG/JPEG (or any arbitrary bytes) would be stored and later fed to ffmpeg as if it were a real music bed. Forcing the check to always pass reproduces exactly that hole, caught by the fixture asserting a PNG renamed `bed.mp3` is refused with 400 naming the accepted audio formats.
